intent_contract.text: 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently invent and visibly test a complex mythic photograph in which three adult fate-workers allocate one adult recipient's lifespan through one continuous thread, while using the supplied portrait only as visible facial and hair appearance guidance for the central worker.

Create a cinematic large-format editorial photograph inside a storm-battered tidal observatory converted into a nocturnal records chamber. Three unmistakably adult women stand around a circular stone worktable, performing a three-stage allocation of one human life by a spun, measured, and cut thread. The left woman spins a fresh luminous red thread from a wooden spindle; the central woman draws that same continuous thread taut against a graduated bronze measuring rule; the right woman closes open iron shears through its far end. Across the table, one adult lighthouse keeper in a wet yellow oilskin holds a clear hourglass token directly beneath the cut point. The severed measured length is visibly falling into the keeper's hourglass, igniting exactly that finite amount of amber sand-light while the unused filament beyond the shears has gone dark. The central measuring woman carries only the reference image's visible facial appearance and loose, long, center-parted dark hair, without any claim of identity. Keep every face, both hands of each worker, spindle, rule, shears, continuous thread path, recipient, and illuminated consequence simultaneously unobstructed. Flooded mosaics mirror the red and amber light beneath a suspended brass astrolabe during blue-hour lightning.
